Bexar County voters abolished the separate County Treasurer office through the constitutional amendment adopted November 6, 1984. The official County Clerk biography states that Lucy Adame-Clark serves as Bexar County Treasurer. This is a consolidated countywide role performed by the elected County Clerk, not a separately elected position.
